title: Davis joins NIDS, Bigelow's institute

tellings.quote: Um I was working at NIDS uh it'd be 30 years this July and I was the director of aerospace physics and astrophysics uh research at NIDS that's national institute for discovery science that Bob Bigalow founded in 1995

plain: The physicist Eric W. Davis says he joined NIDS, the National Institute for Discovery Science, a private group in Las Vegas that the businessman Bob Bigelow founded in 1995 to study unexplained events, and served there as director of aerospace physics and astrophysics research. Davis tells Michels this from his own career, noting it will be "30 years this July," and names colleagues there such as Colm Kelleher and John B. Alexander.
